1.攻城战开始后，有2分钟<color=#FA983A>准备时间</color>。准备时间内，防守公会的成员可以提前进入城堡进行布防。准备时间结束后，攻城战正式开始。

3.攻城战持续<color=#FA983A>30分钟</color>，攻城战结束时，保持占领城堡的公会最终获得城堡归属。
4.在城堡中有4个<color=#FA983A>阵地</color>，保持阵地范围内己方公会的人数最多，即可自动占领阵地。占领阵地后，可以获得<color=#FA983A>攻防属性加成</color>，并且<color=#FA983A>战场资源</color>会随时间自动获取。
5.同时占领多个阵地的情况，战场BUFF效果、战场资源获取效率叠加。
6.团长使用<color=#FA983A>团长技能</color>时，需要消耗战场资源，在合适的时机使用团长技能，可以扭转战局。
Event - Event:
1. After War of Emperium begins, there is a 2-minute <color=#FA983A>preparation time</color>. During it, defending guild members can enter the castle early to set up defenses. When it ends, the siege officially begins.
2. Attacking guild members who <color=#FA983A>destroy the Emperium</color> capture the castle and become its defending guild.
3. The siege lasts <color=#FA983A>30 minutes</color>. When it ends, the guild holding the castle takes ownership.
4. The castle has 4 <color=#FA983A>positions</color>. Have the most guild members within a position's area to capture it automatically. Captured positions grant <color=#FA983A>ATK/DEF bonuses</color>, and <color=#FA983A>battlefield resources</color> accumulate over time.
5. Holding multiple positions stacks battlefield buff effects and resource gain rates.
6. Using <color=#FA983A>Leader Skills</color> costs battlefield resources. Used at the right moment, they can turn the tide.
